title: Tennessee Code Title 50, Chapter 1, Part 6 - Plant Closings and Reduction in Operations
source_id: Tenn. Code Ann. tit. 50, ch. 1, pt. 6
verified_how: expanded the register's table of contents: 'Title 50 Employer And Employee' > 'Chapter 1 Employment Relationship And Practices' > twelve Parts, among them 'Part 6 Plant Closings and Reduction in Operations' and 'Part 8 Retaliatory Discharge', neither carrying a [Repealed] marker. No section text was opened; no currency date is published on the table of contents.
notes: Tennessee's mini-WARN provision: advance notice of a plant closing or a reduction in operations affecting fifty or more employees. Tennessee is an at-will state with no severance-pay entitlement; the wrongful-discharge exceptions are Part 8 (Retaliatory Discharge, the whistleblower statute) and common law. Federal collective redundancy notice is the WARN Act, 29 U.S.C. ch. 23. See the in_force caveat under Payroll/wages.
